name: zachariahayers/galaxymvc
description: A small PHP MVC framework built from scratch: front controller, reflection-checked router, prepared-statement PDO layer and plain PHP views.

scripts.syntax: find app database public tests .php-cs-fixer.dist.php -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.syntax: Lint every PHP file with php -l.
